sample:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/assets/receipt-view.css">
<style>
  .receipt-status { color: #175b44; font-weight: 700; }
</style>

.review-title { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 1.2rem + 2vw, 2.75rem); line-height: 1.15; }
.review-body { font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.55; max-inline-size: 68ch; }

.receipt-card__thumb { inline-size: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; }
.receipt-detail__scan { max-inline-size: 100%; block-size: auto; object-fit: contain; }

.case-summary { box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 24rem; max-inline-size: 100%; padding: 1.25rem; border: 1px solid #aebfcb; }
.case-summary__id { overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.payment-panel { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; margin-block: 0 1.75rem; border: 1px solid #aebfcb; }
.payment-panel__actions { padding-block-start: .75rem; }

.case-note { min-block-size: 7rem; max-inline-size: 68ch; inline-size: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 1rem; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.case-note p { margin-block: 0 .75rem; }

.refund-action { border: 1px solid #41637c; border-radius: .5rem; padding: .7rem 1rem; background: #fff; color: #173148; }
.refund-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #175b44; outline-offset: 3px; }

.shipment-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 17rem), 1fr)); gap: 1rem; }
.shipment-grid__card { min-inline-size: 0; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid #aebfcb; }

.case-header { color: #f7fafc; background-color: #173148; background-image: url("/assets/case-header-texture.webp"); background-size: cover; background-position: 62% center; background-repeat: no-repeat; padding: 2rem 1.5rem; }

.operations-toolbar { font: 500 1rem/1.4 "Case Sans", system-ui, sans-serif; }
.operations-toolbar__count { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

.attachment-preview { inline-size: min(100%, 18rem); aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; overflow: hidden; background: #e7edf1; }
.attachment-preview img { inline-size: 100%; block-size: 100%; object-fit: cover; object-position: center; }

.case-list__row { contain: layout; padding: 1rem; border-block-end: 1px solid #b7c7d0; }
.case-list__row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid #175b44; outline-offset: 2px; }

.receipt-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.receipt-card__status { position: absolute; inset-block-start: .75rem; inset-inline-end: .75rem; z-index: 1; }

.search-field { position: relative; }
.search-field__decoration { position: absolute; inset-inline-start: .8rem; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; }

.audit-entry__drag-handle { user-select: none; cursor: grab; }
.audit-entry__reference { user-select: text; }

html { scroll-padding-block-start: 5rem; }
.incident-report h2[id] { scroll-margin-block-start: 1rem; }

.policy-note { max-inline-size: 32ch; hyphens: auto; overflow-wrap: break-word; }
.policy-note__reference { hyphens: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.archive-spine__label { writing-mode: vertical-rl; inline-size: max-content; max-block-size: 4rem; padding-inline: .5rem; }
@media print { .evidence-card { break-inside: avoid; margin-block-end: .75rem; } }

.case-header { position: relative; isolation: isolate; }
.case-header__accent { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: #dceaf0; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 88% 100%, 0 100%); pointer-events: none; }

.case-summary-overlay { color: #173148; background: rgb(247 250 252 / 94%); }
@supports (backdrop-filter: blur(8px)) { .case-summary-overlay { background: rgb(247 250 252 / 80%); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); } }

.audit-table__resize-grip { cursor: col-resize; inline-size: .75rem; touch-action: none; }
.audit-table__resize-grip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #175b44; }
.case-list { max-block-size: min(70vh, 38rem); overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-gutter: stable; }
.intake-signature__surface { touch-action: none; inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: 12rem; border: 2px solid #41637c; }

.case-card { position: relative; isolation: isolate; background: #e8f0f3; }
.case-card__watermark { mix-blend-mode: multiply; opacity: .25; pointer-events: none; }

.archive-header { position: relative; background: #173148; color: #fff; }
.archive-header__stripe { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0; block-size: .5rem; background: #7fc6d2; mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #000, transparent); pointer-events: none; }
.incident-note__marker { float: inline-start; inline-size: 4.5rem; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 50%; shape-outside: circle(50%); shape-margin: .75rem; margin-inline-end: .5rem; }

.reconciliation-panel { color: #173148; background: #e9f1f3; }
@supports (color: color-mix(in srgb, #24778a, white)) { .reconciliation-panel { background: color-mix(in srgb, #24778a 15%, white); } }

.case-detail { color: #173148; background: #f7fafc; }
@supports (color: light-dark(black, white)) { .case-detail { color-scheme: light dark; color: light-dark(#173148, #f2f7fa); background: light-dark(#f7fafc, #142a38); } }

.payment-table__amount { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: end; white-space: nowrap; }
.payment-summary__count { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

@page { margin: 18mm; }
@media print { .incident-report { color: #111; background: #fff; max-inline-size: none; } }

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; scroll-padding-block-start: 5rem; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { html { scroll-behavior: auto; } }

.exception-note { box-sizing: border-box; inline-size: 100%; min-block-size: 7rem; max-block-size: 18rem; resize: vertical; }
@supports (field-sizing: content) { .exception-note { field-sizing: content; } }

.case-search { color: #f7fafc; background: #173148; caret-color: #f6d77a; }
.case-search:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f6d77a; outline-offset: 2px; }
.operations-toolbar { font-family: 'Ledger Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-size-adjust: 0.55; }

@font-face { font-family: 'Receipt Header'; src: url('/assets/receipt-header.woff2') format('woff2'); font-display: swap; }
.receipt-archive__title { font-family: 'Receipt Header', system-ui, sans-serif; }
.case-summary__heading { max-inline-size: 28ch; text-wrap: balance; }
.diagnostic-excerpt { tab-size: 3; white-space: pre; overflow-x: auto; max-inline-size: 100%; }
.audit-side-panel { max-block-size: 32rem; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-width: thin; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .status-key__swatch { forced-color-adjust: none; border: 2px solid CanvasText; } }

.case-review-card { border: 1px solid #41637c; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgb(23 49 72 / 12%); }
@media (prefers-contrast: more) { .case-review-card { border-width: 3px; box-shadow: none; } }

.case-summary { container-type: inline-size; }
.case-summary__title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 3cqi, 1.8rem); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

.legal-notice { font-family: 'Ledger Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-synthesis-weight: none; }
.legal-notice strong { font-weight: 620; }

@counter-style review-stage { system: fixed; symbols: '①' '②' '③'; suffix: ' '; fallback: decimal; }
.review-steps { list-style-type: decimal; list-style-type: review-stage; padding-inline-start: 2.25rem; }

.case-map { background-color: #e8f1f4; background-image: url('/assets/case-map-1x.webp'); background-size: cover; }
@supports (background-image: image-set(url('/assets/case-map-1x.webp') 1x)) { .case-map { background-image: image-set(url('/assets/case-map-1x.webp') 1x, url('/assets/case-map-2x.webp') 2x); } }

.case-status { border-inline-start: .35rem solid #1f7794; color: #153447; }
@supports (color: color(display-p3 0 0 0)) { @media (color-gamut: p3) { .case-status { border-inline-start-color: color(display-p3 .08 .48 .66); } } }

.payment-exception { color: #163746; background: #eaf3f6; }
@supports (background: oklch(95% .025 220)) { .payment-exception { background: oklch(95% .025 220); } }

.activity-feed { max-block-size: 34rem; overflow-y: auto; }
.activity-feed__loading { overflow-anchor: none; min-block-size: 2rem; }

.review-rail { display: flex; gap: 1rem; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scroll-padding-inline: 1rem; }
.review-rail__card { flex: 0 0 min(18rem, 82vw); scroll-snap-align: start; scroll-snap-stop: always; }

.case-photo__thumb { inline-size: 100%; aspect-ratio: 1; object-fit: cover; object-position: 70% center; }
.case-photo__detail { max-inline-size: 100%; block-size: auto; object-fit: contain; }

.audit-side-panel { max-block-size: 32rem; overflow-y: auto; scrollbar-color: #4d6577 #e6edf1; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .audit-side-panel { scrollbar-color: auto; } }

.case-report a { text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: .1em; text-underline-offset: .16em; text-decoration-skip-ink: auto; }
.case-report a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1c5e87; outline-offset: 2px; }

.transaction-id, .diagnostic-code { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Consolas, monospace; font-variant-ligatures: none; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.case-note { font-variant-ligatures: normal; }

.review-state { text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .04em; font-weight: 600; white-space: normal; }
.person-name, .case-identifier { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: normal; }
.evidence-label { background: #dceef0; color: #153945; padding: .12em .38em; border-radius: .3em; -webkit-box-decoration-break: clone; box-decoration-break: clone; }

.case-confirmation::backdrop { background-color: rgb(12 30 42 / 72%); }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .case-confirmation::backdrop { background-color: Canvas; } }

.case-filter-popover[popover] { max-inline-size: min(22rem, calc(100vw - 2rem)); border: 1px solid #58707d; background: #fff; color: #173441; padding: 1rem; }
.case-filter-popover:popover-open { box-shadow: 0 .8rem 2rem rgb(12 30 42 / 24%); }

.audit-ledger { max-block-size: 29rem; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #78919d; background-image: linear-gradient(#e7f2f4, #fff); background-attachment: local; }
@media print { .audit-ledger { max-block-size: none; overflow: visible; background-image: none; } }

.training-clip::cue { color: #fff; background-color: rgb(12 30 42 / 88%); font-family: sans-serif; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .training-clip::cue { color: CanvasText; background-color: Canvas; } }

.dispatch-map__raster { inline-size: 12rem; block-size: 12rem; image-rendering: pixelated; }
.dispatch-photo { max-inline-size: 100%; block-size: auto; image-rendering: auto; }

.maintenance-note { color: #fff; background-color: #173f56; background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 18%), transparent 55%), linear-gradient(0deg, rgb(0 0 0 / 25%), transparent 70%); background-blend-mode: screen, multiply; padding: 1rem; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { .maintenance-note { background-image: none; border: 1px solid CanvasText; } }
@media print { .incident-report p { orphans: 2; widows: 2; } .incident-report h2 { break-after: avoid; } .incident-report { color: #000; background: #fff; } }

@media print { .custody-table { print-color-adjust: exact; } .custody-table :is(th, td) { border-block-end: 1px solid #66747a; } .custody-table tr:nth-child(even) { background: #eef2f3; } .custody-table .hold-label { color: #111; font-weight: 700; } }

review-badge::part(label) { font-weight: 700; text-decoration-thickness: .12em; text-underline-offset: .16em; }
review-badge[status="held"]::part(label) { text-decoration-line: underline; }

slot[name="title"] { color: #173441; }
::slotted([slot="title"]) { display: block; margin: 0; font: 700 1.2rem/1.35 system-ui; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

::highlight(policy-search-match) { color: #163441; background-color: #ffe28a; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { ::highlight(policy-search-match) { color: HighlightText; background-color: Highlight; } }

review-gate { display: block; padding: .85rem; color: #173441; border: 1px solid #62808c; }
@supports selector(:state(pending-review)) { review-gate:state(pending-review) { border-inline-start: .4rem solid #915a22; background: #fff4df; } }

::target-text { color: #173441; background-color: #ffe29a; }
@media (forced-colors: active) { ::target-text { color: HighlightText; background-color: Highlight; } }

.training-video { display: block; max-inline-size: 100%; border: 2px solid #6b8490; }
@supports selector(:picture-in-picture) { .training-video:picture-in-picture { border-color: #235d77; outline: 2px solid #235d77; } }
